A flat vivid periwinkle-blue (#7472E8) rounded-square tile fills the canvas with clean rounded corners and true transparency outside the tile. Inside, an antique natural-history wood engraving of an inquisitive raven in three-quarter profile, head and upper breast filling most of the tile, facing left. Fine black ink crosshatching and warm ivory highlights, strong recognizable silhouette, detailed feathers, a bright observant eye. One simple small antique magnifying glass is held beside the raven's breast and reinforces research without obscuring its face. The engraving has a crisp cutout edge directly on the solid colour, just like the fox, dragon, owl, lynx and lion ArtCraft animal icons. Maintain legibility at 48x48 pixels. Tight crop, raven large, tile and engraving flat, no 3D, no gradients, no shadow, no sticker rim, no surrounding margin, no decorative background, no letters. 1024x1024 square output with alpha only beyond the rounded corners.
